# {{ site.title }} (NAMBA)

> NAMBA is a volunteer-led nonprofit in Niseko, Hokkaido, Japan, building Asia's premier mountain bike destination: 21km+ of free-to-ride, Swiss-designed singletrack and a growing trail-building community.

The Niseko Area Mountain Bike Association (NAMBA) builds and maintains free-access mountain bike trails in the Niseko area of Hokkaido, Japan. This site is bilingual: the English pages are listed below, and a Japanese mirror of every page is served under the `/ja/` prefix (for example, https://namba.ngo/ja/twin-peaks/). Events, jobs, and competitions are published as dated posts under their sections.
